name: Lieke de Vries
bio:
Lieke's journey into motorsport began with a fascination for precision engineering, sparked by her grandfather's work on vintage motorcycles. After graduating with a degree in Mechanical Engineering from Delft University of Technology, she honed her skills at a local automotive workshop before joining Opala Legends. Her meticulous approach to fabrication ensures that every component meets the highest standards of quality and performance. 

Lieke's expertise lies in welding and composite materials, she is particularly skilled in TIG welding, producing clean, strong joints under pressure. She believes in a collaborative approach, constantly seeking feedback from engineers and drivers to refine her work. Her colleagues appreciate her calm demeanor and ability to troubleshoot complex problems under tight deadlines, always delivering practical solutions that keep the team on track.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, often tied back in a practical braid.
physical.description: Lieke has a determined look and a build that suggests both strength and precision.

quirks: Always sharpens her pencils to exactly the same length before starting a new project.
Keeps a small collection of antique tools in her locker.
Insists on using a specific type of welding mask, claiming it improves her concentration.
